cohort: The study included 150 patients presenting with preterm labour, with gestational ages between 34-37 weeks and no neonatal congenital anomalies on anomaly scan, who were recruited from Nishtar Hospital Multan.
finding: Prenatal corticosteroid therapy administered prior to caesarean delivery at 34-37 weeks of gestation significantly reduced neonatal respiratory morbidity, with a rate of 2.7% in the corticosteroid group compared to 9.3% in the control group.
